name: The Taj Mahal Palace, Mumbai
tagline: India's iconic legendary luxury landmark overlooking the Arabian Sea
features: Panoramic Arabian Sea & Gateway of India Views
10 Legendary Fine Dining Restaurants including Wasabi & Golden Dragon
J Wellness Circle Traditional Ayurvedic Spa & Heritage Art Collection
description: Opened in 1903, The Taj Mahal Palace is Mumbai's first harbor landmark and one of the most famous grand luxury hotels in the world. Blending Moorish, Oriental, and Florentine architectural styles, it features vaulted alabaster ceilings, onyx columns, hand-woven silk carpets, and crystal chandeliers, having hosted royalty, dignitaries, and celebrities for over a century.

name: The Oberoi Udaivilas, Udaipur
tagline: Voted World's #1 Hotel atop the romantic waters of Lake Pichola
features: Private Shikara Boat Arrival Across Lake Pichola
Semi-Private Moat Pools Directly Accessible from Luxury Rooms
50-Acre Wildlife Sanctuary with Peacocks & Spotted Deer
Hand-Painted Gold Leaf Domes, Whispering Fountains & Mewar Arches
description: Set on the tranquil shores of Lake Pichola, The Oberoi Udaivilas stands on the 200-year-old hunting grounds of the Maharana of Mewar. Featuring interconnecting domes, corridors of archways, whispering fountains, and reflection pools, this breathtaking sanctuary offers unparalleled royal Rajasthani hospitality.

name: Rambagh Palace, Jaipur
tagline: The former residence of the Maharaja of Jaipur — 'The Jewel of Jaipur'
features: Authentic Maharaja Royal Palace Built in 1835
47 Acres of Manicured Mughal Gardens with Dancing Peacocks
Vintage Horse-Drawn Carriage Ride on Royal Arrival
Suvarna Mahal Fine Dining Under 24-Carat Gold Leaf Ceilings
description: Widely celebrated as 'The Jewel of Jaipur', Rambagh Palace was the former residence of Maharaja Sawai Man Singh II and his queen, Maharani Gayatri Devi. Retaining its elaborate marble lattice work (jali), sandstone balustrades, and cupolas, guests enjoy extravagant royal luxury, polo lounge high teas, and personalized palace butler care.
